pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE LORD’S PRAYER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.4: The Lord’s Prayer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Lord’s Prayer
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you pray always as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. pray for parents, guardians and friends
2. say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: pray for parents, guardians and friends

Teach
• Today’s focus: pray for parents, guardians and friends.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “pray for parents, guardians and friends” using a school example.
• Model B for “pray for parents, guardians and friends” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "pray for parents, guardians and friends" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually

Teach
• Today’s focus: say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually” using a school example.
• Model B for “say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: pray for parents, guardians and friends
• Model 2: say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: pray for parents, guardians and friends
2. Practise: say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Lord’s Prayer.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you pray always as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• pray for parents, guardians and friends
• say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
